description: This file provides utility functions and a data class for handling pagination in a database querying context. It includes functions to compute pagination parameters and to count total records for a given SQLAlchemy select statement.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: A data class representing pagination parameters: page number, page size, offset, and limit.

methods.name: Page compute_page(*, page: int, page_size: int)
methods.description: Calculates offset and limit for pagination based on a 1-based page number and page size.

methods.name: int count_total(db: Session, stmt: Select)
methods.description: Counts the total number of rows matching a given SQLAlchemy select statement, optimized by dropping ordering.

ctags.name: compute_page
ctags.pattern: /^def compute_page(*, page: int, page_size: int) -> Page:$/
